## 1. The Priestly Course Engine: Deterministic Calendrical Proof
**Source:** https://jubilee2040.com/01-priestly-courses.html

The 24 Priestly Courses (1 Chronicles 24) operated as a high-precision, liturgical clock running continuously for over 600 years. Historical records provide three independent anchor points:
- **First Temple Destruction (530 BC):** Talmud (Taanit 29a) records the 1st course (Jehoiarib) was on duty.
- **Ministry of Zacharias (4 BC):** Luke 1:5 places him in the 8th course (Abijah) during the 7th lunar month.
- **Second Temple Destruction (70 AD):** Talmud confirms the 1st course was again on duty.

**Three-Point Lock Test:**
| Test              | Tretter Prediction | Conventional Prediction | Historical Fact | Verdict          |
|-------------------|-------------------|------------------------|-----------------|------------------|
| Zacharias (4 BC)  | Course #8         | Course #7              | Course #8       | TC: PERFECT MATCH |
| 70 AD Destruction | Course #1         | Course #8              | Course #1       | TC: PERFECT MATCH |

The conventional 586 BC anchor fails both tests. The Tretter Chronology's 530 BC anchor is the only date that mathematically aligns with all three historical records.

## 2. The Jubilee Master Clock
**Source:** https://jubilee2040.com/02-jubilee-cycles.html

The Jubilee system (Leviticus 25) functions as the Bible's supreme timekeeping architecture:
- 1 Sabbatical Cycle = 7 years
- 1 Jubilee Cycle = 7 Sabbatical cycles = 49 years
- Genesis 6:3 ("120 years") encodes a 120-Jubilee master cycle (120 × 49 = 5,880 years) spanning Creation to Christ's return.

**The Jordan Crossing Anchor:**
The Book of Jubilees 50:4 provides a self-contained mathematical proof:
- 49 full Jubilees = 2,401 years from Adam
- "One week and two years" into the 50th cycle = 9 years elapsed
- "40 years to come" until crossing the Jordan
- **Result:** Jordan Crossing occurs in Year 49 of the 50th Jubilee = **2450 A.M. (Anno Mundi)**. This establishes the definitive "Golden Spike" anchoring the entire 120-Jubilee framework.

## 3. The Three Prophetic Blocks (950-Year Chain)
**Source:** https://jubilee2040.com/03-prophetic-blocks.html

Three prophetic durations form a contiguous, unbreakable 950-year chain:
- **Block 1 (390 years):** Ezekiel 4 — From the 5th year of Rehoboam (~919 BC) to the First Temple's destruction (~530 BC)
- **Block 2 (70 years):** Jeremiah 25 — The Babylonian exile, measured in Tishri-to-Tishri prophetic years (Tishri 530 BC → Tishri 460 BC). Equals the exact count of missed Sabbatical/Jubilee years (2 Chronicles 36:21). The exile concludes precisely at the start of the **70th Jubilee**.
- **Block 3 (490 years):** Daniel 9 — The "Seventy Weeks" countdown beginning at the 70th Jubilee (Tishri 460 BC) and terminating at the Crucifixion & Resurrection (31 AD)

The blocks are contiguous. The end of each block is the start of the next. Moving either bookend breaks the chain. Conventional chronology fails this test; the Tretter Chronology satisfies all three blocks simultaneously with year-level precision.

## 4. The 480-Year Paradox Solved (1 Kings 6:1)
**Source:** https://jubilee2040.com/04-480-paradox.html

1 Kings 6:1 states Solomon began building the Temple in the "480th year" after the Exodus. The Tretter Chronology reveals this is a prophetic Jubilee count:
- **Start Anchor:** Jordan Crossing Jubilee begins Tishri 1440 BC
- **Prophetic Duration:** 10 Jubilee cycles = 490 years
- **Calculation:** 1440 BC (Tishri) − 490 years = 950 BC (Tishri)
- **Result:** The 490-year cycle culminates in the exact Jubilee year of Solomon's Temple dedication (950 BC). The "480" is a narrative rounding of the underlying 490-year Jubilee architecture.

- 55 Missed Sabbatical Years (applying "Incomplete Week" principle)
- 6 Overlap Sabbatical Years (570–530 BC, both kingdoms violating simultaneously)
- 8 Missed Jubilee Years (sacred 50th years counted separately)
- 1 Overlap Jubilee Year (558 BC, double violation)
**Total:** 55 + 6 + 8 + 1 = 70. Exact biblical match. No other chronology can produce this list.
